name: weekly_workforce
label: Weekly workforce snapshot
description: Lightweight headcount/availability report any department can use. Captures who's on the books, who's out sick, who's brought in on contract, and the overtime burden for the week.
notes: Designed as a starter schema — drop it on any service to get something flowing without committing to a domain-specific template.

values.name: employees_active
values.label: Active employees
values.description: Total headcount on the payroll for this week, including anyone on leave.

values.name: sick_leave
values.label: On sick leave
values.description: Number of active employees who called in sick at least once during the week.

values.name: contractors
values.label: Contractors on site
values.description: External contractors working alongside employees this week (counted by unique person, not by hour).

values.name: overtime_hours
values.label: Overtime hours
values.description: Total overtime hours logged by employees and contractors combined. Leave empty if no overtime was worked.
values.valueValidation: if(overtime_hours < 0, 'Overtime hours cannot be negative.', null)
values.warning: if(overtime_hours > 100, 'Overtime above 100 hours — review against budget.', null)

layout.caption: Staffing
layout.description: Who's on the books this week.
